Your board. Your address.

Chess Lens runs its engine in your browser. The current version needs static hosting, with no analysis server or API key.

Start local, host when you want access anywhere.

Localhost is ideal for development. A hosted URL lets you use the app on your phone and computer without leaving a computer running. A custom domain is an optional memorable address, separate from hosting.

Two good hosting fits

Cloudflare Pages: static asset requests are free and unlimited on free and paid plans; build and project limits still apply. Official pricing.

Vercel Hobby: a free option for personal, non-commercial projects within usage limits. Official terms and limits.

What does a domain cost?

Checked 31 October 2026: Cloudflare lists standard .com registration and renewal at $10.46. Plan roughly $10–20/year for a conventional available name; premium names, taxes and other suffixes may differ. No domain has been purchased or checked for availability. Current domain pricing.

A private repository does not automatically make a deployed app private. Preserve your intended audience when moving hosts.
